reading.body:
This facility in Edison, New Jersey is a data center formerly operated as IO Datacenter and acquired by Iron Mountain in 2018. The published specifications provided do not include power capacity, rack count, cooling capacity, or any technical figure that would allow assessment of its scale or suitability for AI workloads. Without these figures, the campus cannot be evaluated against the thesis that grid availability constrains AI scaling.

New Jersey has published power capacity figures for only five facilities statewide, totaling 111.3 MW across all of them. This campus ranks sixth by published megawatts in the state, meaning it either publishes no capacity figure or publishes a figure smaller than all five of the disclosed facilities. The state context does not clarify which is the case.

No certifications, renewable energy attributes, cooling technology, power purchase agreements, or grid interconnection details are published for this site. The facility exists as a mapped location with no public technical specification. It cannot be placed in any ranking of capacity relevant to AI infrastructure decisions.
